description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for Orleans transaction tests using xUnit. It extends a base class and provides specific test methods with different transaction scenarios, utilizing attributes for parameterized testing.

classes.name: ScopedTransactionsTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: An abstract class for running Orleans transaction tests with xUnit, providing methods for different transaction scenarios.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValue
methods.description: Overrides base method to test creating a transaction scope and setting a value with different grain states.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueWithFailure
methods.description: Overrides base method to test transaction scope creation with a failure scenario.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndAssert
methods.description: Overrides base method to create a transaction scope, set a value, and perform assertions.

methods.name: CreateNestedTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndInnerFailAndAssert
methods.description: Overrides base method to test nested transaction scopes with inner failure and assertions.
